name: 102.1 — the catalogue, and the surface a string is drawn at
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 102.1: hafen.locale() -- one catalogue per addon, loaded as a document, installed and released like a stylesheet, and read back through the strings it did not answer. It builds a button and a label both reading one word, and proves that a key names ONE surface (an entry under `button` reaches the caption and not the label, whose surface is `default`), that an entry under `*` answers both, that an EMPTY catalogue still records every pair that missed -- which is what writing the first file needs -- that a released one records nothing at all, that the model is not translated (:text() still answers the client's own English), and that a surface drawing no text, `textentry`, an unknown property and a nil document are each refused saying why.
